assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction for a native Godot layered 2D game. EDIT TARGET is the supplied 1672x941 window landscape. Output ONE registered transparent RGBA layer with a REAL alpha channel. Keep EXACT canvas size, camera, pixel scale and original placement of the retained objects; do not crop, zoom, reframe, center or reposition them. This is an animation layer separated from an existing painting, NOT a new composition. Preserve hand-drawn pixel clusters, architecture and object identities. Use neutral diffuse material colors without weather, moon/sun light shafts, cloud shadows or emissive glow; runtime will relight it. All excluded regions must be truly alpha=0, no checkerboard painted into the image, no black/white matte, no text. Extend retained terrain behind occluding foreground objects where requested so it can be recomposited without holes. RETAIN ONLY the distant snowy mountain chain and the layered forested foothills behind the town. Keep the main snow peak at its original horizontal and vertical position (roughly x720,y250 on this canvas), with other ridges at original elevations. Reconstruct the range all the way across the full width behind the removed left tree and right house. The mountain/foothill layer should end around the far valley elevation, with its lower silhouette hidden later behind the town/shore layer. REMOVE entire sky, clouds, sun, all river water, towns/buildings, near banks, tree, plants, balcony, railing, window frame, mug and book. Everything outside mountain and forested foothill terrain is TRANSPARENT, including sky above mountain ridge and bottom half.

Use case: background-extraction / game animation sprite. Input image is a reference and extraction source for the named subject. Create ONE beautiful detailed hand-drawn pixel-art game sprite isolated on REAL TRANSPARENT RGBA background. The sprite will be independently animated over a different landscape. Keep its style and characteristic shape from the reference. Center the subject in a compact landscape canvas with around 8 percent transparent padding on each side; use most of the canvas for the subject, not a miniature. NO scenery, no sky, no mountains, no water surface, no ground, no frame, no UI, no cast shadow plane, no text or checkerboard. Remove ALL environmental pixels and any background haze. Keep natural semitransparency only within luminous creature material. Crisp pixel clusters, refined pixel shading, limited harmonious palette, no thick cartoon outline. SUBJECT: the colossal old god's shadowy head and spread tentacles from the clouds. Retain ONE complete distant creature silhouette, including tentacles stretched wide on both sides and curving down; center the head slightly high. Dark petrol-green body, muted green ridges, tiny jade eyes. Remove the clouds covering it and reconstruct the concealed parts so it is a self-contained complete head-plus-tentacles creature cutout. Subtle dark translucent edges but enough solid detail to read against sky. No fog/cloud backdrop, no sea, no landscape, no stars, no attacks or gore. Wide aspect about 2:1.
